requests.prompt: App icon for an Android multi-plan time management app called Wake Plan. Design language: deep dark navy background color #0B1426 with rounded square shape and soft inner glow. App icon for an Android multi-plan time management app called Wake Plan. Design language: deep dark navy background color #0B1426 with rounded square shape and soft inner glow. Centered composition: three equal-sized small day-cards stacked tightly with subtle vertical offset and very slight tilt (top card slightly tilted right by 3 degrees, middle card straight, bottom card slightly tilted left by 3 degrees), each card a rounded rectangle in dark navy with a soft glow border in a distinct color: top card border pink #EC4899, middle card border sky blue #3B82F6, bottom card border mint green #10B981. Each card has a small dot or icon in the upper-left of the card to suggest a plan tag. Cards are arranged so all three are clearly visible with comfortable margin from icon edge.
